executive_summary: Build only the native extension on the audited pinned baseline; run selected correctness, component diagnostics and fixed paired timing as separately dispatched stages.
phase1: No Docker, builds, component timing or performance loops may run before explicit coordinator dispatch.
correctness: 13 assigned market configurations, 7 lifecycle and 12 message columns in standalone O2/ASan/UBSan; strict pinned Docker comparisons additionally require both parquet journals byte/schema/ordered-value exactness, unchanged shared gates and actual native execution.
component: Real logs captured from each of the four assigned timing units by the actual original native engine. Both sides replay the identical immutable chronological input. Actual original logging/capture plus Sim::extract against all candidate append/flush/finish work. One excluded warmup per side then five AB/BA pairs per unit. Both output columns compare exactly. Initial simulation, replay preparation and equality are excluded. Component series excluded from full-run speed medians.

policy.correctness: Exact bytes, schema and ordered values of BOTH journals, shared developer gates, actual native execution per market. Correctness-only scenarios excluded from speed conclusions.
